subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should this PR land with immediate quarantine of pre-evidence Gitcrawl jobs, or only after existing queued jobs are migrated or archived?
rationale: The implementation deliberately stops legacy Gitcrawl jobs from rendering worker prompts, and only repository operators can choose the safe durable-state rollout boundary.

options.title: Migrate before merge
options.body: Inventory and re-import or archive existing Gitcrawl jobs before enabling mandatory packet verification.

options.title: Accept immediate quarantine
options.body: Merge with explicit operator acknowledgement that legacy jobs stop rendering until handled manually.

options.title: Stage enforcement separately
options.body: Land evidence acquisition first and enable mandatory prompt verification only after migration proof.

recommendation.title: Migrate before merge
recommendation.body: Inventory and re-import or archive existing Gitcrawl jobs before enabling mandatory packet verification.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the existing Gitcrawl importer history and authored the proposed cutover.
